remarks: Discover the potential of 19 Morningside Drive, a home with a solid structure, high ceilings, and a prime location on nearly half an acre. Offering 4,161 sq. ft. of living space, the open floor plan features spacious rooms, providing a perfect canvas for your renovation ideas. The outdoor area boasts a large patio with a built-in grill, ideal for entertaining, along with a sparkling pool that overlooks the serene backdrop of the adjacent golf course. This property offers a rare opportunity to create your dream home in a tranquil and desirable setting.
